svg.title: Figure 1 · Hazard register
svg.desc: Every hazard with its preliminary risk and the records that control it
svg.text: 22 hazards (22 open). Initial risk: 8 High, 2 Medium, 12 Serious; target risk after planned mitigation: 21 Medium, 1 Serious. Preliminary; none
Rotor start while UAV is retained or a person is at the
False retained state releases UAV under motion
UAV battery thermal event while charging on the dock
Exposure to energised dock charging contacts
Fall from height during maintenance on the walker
UAV launch or recovery outside the safe envelope
Pilot acts on misleading or stale UAV information
Person struck or pinned by the arms or claws
Carried load swings, shifts or drops while walking
Unintended leg motion during pilot ingress or egress
Uncontrolled vertical drop of the cockpit on loss of leg
Fall from height during emergency egress
Normal egress blocked when the walker cannot lower
Fall during normal ingress or egress
Delayed or unsafe extraction of an incapacitated pilot
Battery thermal runaway near the pilot station
Fuel leak and fire at the engine-generator
Protective stop does not reach a safe state
Stale or lost feedback causes runaway motion
Walker tip-over or fall with pilot aboard
Crushing under the pod or legs while kneeling or rising

Generated by tools/figures/safety_readme.py from safety/hazards/, safety/software/, safety/events/ and the 882E catalog. Risk levels are preliminary qualitative judgements; nothing is verified or accepted. Pills
are risk assessment codes (severity 1–4, probability A–F); event risk is for the first event the hazard applies to.

g.text: Terms: 1A–4F = risk assessment code, severity 1–4 plus probability A–F (e.g. 1C) · 3D = three-dimensional · F-nnn = system function in the item definition · HAZ-nnn = hazard record
(safety/hazards/HAZ-xxx-nnn.yaml) · SSF-nnn = safety-significant software function record (safety/software/) · UAV = uncrewed aerial vehicle (drone)
